propositions: Cloud ADF encode must parse Markdown syntax (headings, lists, code blocks, inline formatting) rather than treating them as literal text
The combined strong+strikethrough mark order alternates indefinitely (2-cycle) across round-trips and requires deterministic canonicalization to stabilize
HTML comments in source text are dropped by marklas and must be detected and preserved via self-verification fallback to plain encode
Functions must degrade gracefully to plain-text ADF when marklas/mistune are absent, preserving stdlib-only engine contract via lazy import
Markdown-aware serialization fit-measurement must account for the actual encoded ADF output, not the raw Markdown length
Over committed 360-body corpus, ≥99.6% of bodies must reach idempotence fixed point in one round-trip pass and ≥15% must encode to structurally rich ADF with block-level nodes
